about: Saanich is the most populous municipality in Greater Victoria, on the Saanich Peninsula of Vancouver Island. It is a largely residential district wrapping around the City of Victoria, from urban neighbourhoods to farms and rocky coastline. The University of Victoria campus sits on its eastern side. About 120,000 people live in Saanich.
seoSummary: Greater Victoria’s largest municipality, from suburban neighbourhoods to peninsula farms.
